description: This file contains functions for detecting collisions and hit-testing between graphical elements in a drawing application, including shape intersection, point-in-shape checks, and bounding box calculations.

methods.name: shouldTestInside
methods.description: Determines if an element should be tested for inside hit detection based on its type and properties.

methods.name: hitElementItself
methods.description: Performs a hit test to check if a point hits the element itself, considering bounding box, rotation, and frame name.

methods.name: hitElementBoundingBox
methods.description: Checks if a point is within the bounding box of an element.

methods.name: hitElementBoundingBoxOnly
methods.description: Checks if a point hits the bounding box of an element, excluding the element itself and bound text.

methods.name: hitElementBoundText
methods.description: Checks if a point hits the bound text associated with an element.

methods.name: getAllHoveredElementAtPoint
methods.description: Returns all elements at a point that are candidates for hover, ordered from topmost.

methods.name: getHoveredElementForBinding
methods.description: Returns the topmost bindable element at a point for binding purposes.

methods.name: intersectElementWithLineSegment
methods.description: Calculates intersection points between a line segment and an element's shape.

methods.name: isPointOnElementOutline
methods.description: Checks if a point is on the outline of an element within a tolerance.

methods.name: isPointInElement
methods.description: Determines if a point is inside an element's shape.

methods.name: isBindableElementInsideOtherBindable
methods.description: Checks if one bindable element is inside another bindable element.
